declarations.title: Selected App Service and Function literal app settings have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected app settings and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use managed identity or Key Vault references where appropriate.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in selected literal app settings.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

fixture.origin: Independent exact ARM GET identity and read-only POST appsettings/list through Azure collector and engine; real pinned Kingfisher 1.4.0/TruffleHog 3.92.5 for PASS/FAIL, native 403 for UNKNOWN; no cloud/auth/verification.
